0022600006.text: The 76ers, who are 1-0 and first in the Atlantic, host the Cleveland Cavaliers in Philadelphia's second game of the 2026-27 season, and this is Cleveland's season opener. Philadelphia lost all four meetings with Cleveland in 2025-26, most recently 115-101 in Cleveland on March 9, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet this season. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, ruptured), Dean Wade (ankle, sprain), Dominick Barlow (back), and Tacko Fall (hip), while Cleveland is without Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) and has Khalifa Diop (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
